text: Security is a vital part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. Second, implement strong authentication, such as passwords and two-factor verification, to confirm user identity. Third, validate all input to prevent malicious code from entering your system. Common vulnerabilities include SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and cross-site request forgery. If developers ignore these risks, attackers can steal data or take control of accounts. Therefore, building security into every stage of a project is essential for protecting both users and businesses.
